'''Elliott Weights'''<ref name="dt-21738">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21738 DeckTech post 21738], DeckTech (Elliott "Dengar 69" Weights, 25 February 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21738/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21738/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Dengar 69''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list on DeckTech in February 2002.
